name: Karina Petrova
source:
Karina looks like a pretty and slender woman between 30-40 years old, dark-haired, of medium height, with green eyes. She is dressed in a dark dress with a large neckline, over which she sometimes wears a white apron with flowers. She wears earrings and a chain around her neck.

Outside, Karina wears an ankle-length black fur coat, a large fur hat, and black high-heeled boots.
